title: India's Defence Minister Rejects Broader Talks with Pakistan
summary: Defence minister Rajnath Singh stated that India will only engage in talks with Pakistan over the disputed region of PoK. He rejected broader talks, citing Pakistan's alleged promotion of terrorism as a state policy. Singh made this statement during Kargil Vijay Diwas celebrations. The Defence Minister also mentioned Operation Sindoor, which he claimed sent a clear message to Pakistan. India has been seeking a resolution on the Kashmir issue for years.
summary_points: Defence minister Rajnath Singh stated that India will only engage in talks with Pakistan over PoK
Singh rejected broader talks, citing Pakistan's alleged promotion of terrorism as a state policy
Operation Sindoor was mentioned by Singh as sending a clear message to Pakistan
The Defence Minister made this statement during Kargil Vijay Diwas celebrations
